description: Structure of the Job Search Full-Ops Agent tracking spreadsheet. Onboarding (Phase 7) builds the 'Template' tab from this file; every run (SKILL.md Step 9) copies that tab for the new period and fills the rows. Column names must match config.json tracking.columns, in the same order.

columns.name: Location / Work Type
columns.format_hint: Starts with Remote / Hybrid / Onsite, e.g. 'Hybrid, Berlin (DE)' or 'Remote (EU)'.

columns.name: Source
columns.format_hint: The board's name from config.json, or 'Manual' for links the user sent.

columns.name: Apply Link
columns.format_hint: Canonical job URL without utm_* or other tracking parameters.

columns.name: CV Action
columns.format_hint: Every job at or above min_fit_score gets its own tailored CV. 'Not tailored' only when the CV could not be produced (e.g. it couldn't be fitted to one page); the reason goes in the notes.

columns.name: Tailored CV Link
columns.format_hint: Drive link to the PDF, or its absolute local path when Drive is not used. PDF only.

columns.name: Application Status
columns.rule: The agent writes 'New' on new rows only. It never changes a status the user has set.

columns.name: AI Fit & Tailoring Notes
columns.format_hint: 1-3 sentences: why it fits, main gaps, flags (junior level, salary below floor, language), keyword coverage, e.g. 'must 7/7, nice 3/4'.

columns.name: ATS Keywords Matched
columns.format_hint: Comma-separated, in the job post's spelling. Learning-line keywords end with '(learning)'.

columns.name: ATS Keywords Missing
columns.format_hint: Comma-separated keywords the profile doesn't support. They are asked about in the digest.

columns.name: Job ID
columns.format_hint: <board id>-<board's job id>, or a hash of the canonical URL. Used to de-duplicate across runs.
